items.source: Spring HATEOAS ships with a representation model class (PagedModel/SlicedModel) that allows enriching the content of a Page or Slice instance with the necessary Page/Slice metadata as well as links to let the clients easily navigate the pages. The conversion of a Page to a PagedModel is done by an implementation of the Spring HATEOAS RepresentationModelAssembler interface, called the PagedResourcesAssembler. Similarly Slice instances can be converted to a SlicedModel using a SlicedResourcesAssembler. The following example shows how to use a PagedResourcesAssembler as a controller method argument, as the SlicedResourcesAssembler works exactly the same:
items.translation: Spring HATEOAS 附带了表示模型类（PagedModel/SlicedModel），它们允许为 Page 或 Slice 实例的内容丰富必要的 Page/Slice 元数据以及链接，以便客户端能够轻松导航页面。 将 Page 转换为 PagedModel 是通过实现 Spring HATEOAS RepresentationModelAssembler 接口的 PagedResourcesAssembler 完成的。 同样地，可以使用 SlicedResourcesAssembler 将 Slice 实例转换为 SlicedModel。 以下示例展示了如何将 PagedResourcesAssembler 用作控制器方法参数，SlicedResourcesAssembler 的工作方式完全相同：

items.source: You can use the type shown in the preceding example as a Spring MVC handler method argument or by using ParameterizedTypeReference on one of methods of the RestTemplate. The preceding method declarations would try to find firstname anywhere in the given document. The lastname XML lookup is performed on the top-level of the incoming document. The JSON variant of that tries a top-level lastname first but also tries lastname nested in a user sub-document if the former does not return a value. That way, changes in the structure of the source document can be mitigated easily without having clients calling the exposed methods (usually a drawback of class-based payload binding).
items.translation: 您可以使用前面示例中所示的类型作为 Spring MVC 处理器方法参数，或者在 RestTemplate 的某个方法上使用 ParameterizedTypeReference。 前述方法声明将尝试在整个给定文档的任何位置查找 firstname。 lastname 的 XML 查找是在传入文档的顶层执行的。 该功能的 JSON 变体首先尝试顶层的 lastname，但如果前者未返回值，还会尝试在 user 子文档中查找嵌套的 lastname。 这样，可以轻松缓解源文档结构变化带来的影响，而无需客户端调用已暴露的方法（这通常是基于类的负载绑定方法的一个缺点）。

items.source: It’s common for Spring MVC controllers to try to ultimately render a representation of a Spring Data page to clients. While one could simply return Page instances from handler methods to let Jackson render them as is, we strongly recommend against this as the underlying implementation class PageImpl is a domain type. This means we might want or have to change its API for unrelated reasons, and such changes might alter the resulting JSON representation in a breaking way.
items.translation: Spring MVC 控制器通常尝试最终将 Spring Data 页面的表示形式渲染给客户端。虽然可以直接从处理器方法返回 Page 实例，让 Jackson 按原样进行渲染，但我们强烈不建议这样做，因为底层实现类 PageImpl 是一个领域类型。这意味着我们可能出于无关的原因需要或必须更改其 API，而此类更改可能会以破坏性的方式改变生成的 JSON 表示形式。

items.source: With Spring Data 3.1, we started hinting at the problem by issuing a warning log describing the problem. We still ultimately recommend to leverage the integration with Spring HATEOAS for a fully stable and hypermedia-enabled way of rendering pages that easily allow clients to navigate them. But as of version 3.3 Spring Data ships a page rendering mechanism that is convenient to use but does not require the inclusion of Spring HATEOAS.
items.translation: 在 Spring Data 3.1 版本中，我们通过发出描述该问题的警告日志来提示此问题。我们仍然最终推荐使用与 Spring HATEOAS 的集成，以提供完全稳定且支持超媒体的页面渲染方式，从而轻松允许客户端进行导航。但从版本 3.3 开始，Spring Data 提供了一个方便使用的页面渲染机制，无需包含 Spring HATEOAS。

Those can be activated by using its @EnableHypermediaSupport annotation. Find more information in the Spring HATEOAS reference documentation.

items.source: tools.jackson.databind is the Jackson 3 package prefix. Jackson 2 used com.fasterxml.jackson.databind. Jackson 2 support is deprecated and will be removed in a future release; see the Jackson 3 migration guide for upgrade instructions.

items.source: By default, binding collection-like properties is capped at 1024 entries. You can override this limit by setting the spring.data.web.projection.collection-limit property through a spring.properties file or as a system property.
items.translation: 默认情况下，绑定集合类属性的条目数上限为 1024。您可以通过在 spring.properties 文件中设置 spring.data.web.projection.collection-limit 属性，或将其作为系统属性来覆盖此限制。

items.source: Type information is typically resolved from the method’s return type. Since that information does not necessarily match the domain type, it might be a good idea to use the root attribute of QuerydslPredicate.
items.translation: 类型信息通常从方法的返回类型中解析。由于该信息不一定与域类型匹配，因此使用 QuerydslPredicate 的 root 属性可能是一个不错的选择。

items.source: You can register a QuerydslBinderCustomizerDefaults bean holding default Querydsl bindings before applying specific bindings from the repository or @QuerydslPredicate.
items.translation: 您可以在应用来自仓库或 @QuerydslPredicate 的具体绑定之前，注册一个持有默认 Querydsl 绑定的 QuerydslBinderCustomizerDefaults Bean。

items.source: Currently, the repository has to implement CrudRepository to be eligible to be discovered for conversion.
items.translation: 目前，仓库必须实现 CrudRepository 才有资格被识别用于转换。
